title: Xerxes and Alexander visited the sites

tellings.quote: for instance these sites were visited by Xerxes Alexander the Great and many many other great people throughout history

plain: The ancient sites around Lake Van, in eastern Turkey, were visited by the Persian king Xerxes, by Alexander the Great and by "many many other great people throughout history," according to the researcher Matt LaCroix. He tells Michels this without naming a source, in a conversation about something he believes happened around 12,000 BC. His point is that rulers of the ancient world treated these places as important long after they were built.
